scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving personal care services
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Personal Care Services
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: personal care services — a misunderstanding or problem involving personal care services
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving personal care services; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Mr Michael she thinks there is a mix-up with her booking.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với anh Michael hình như lịch đặt của mình bị nhầm.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Michael. I think there is a mix-up with my booking.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh Michael. Hình như lịch đặt của tôi bị nhầm rồi.

turns.speaker: Mr Michael
turns.english: Let me look into that for you.
turns.vietnamese: Để tôi kiểm tra giúp chị.

turns.speaker: Mr Michael
turns.english: I am sorry for the confusion.
turns.vietnamese: Tôi xin lỗi vì sự nhầm lẫn này.
